value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of an information-theoretic invariant across all 18 semigroup-defined three-state rules, with exact all-length joint observable language sizes. It separates five genuinely exponentially rich observer traces from thirteen polynomial/bounded ones despite all 18 being explicitly solvable, and it isolates the absorbing/group rule G4 as a counterintuitive positive-entropy trace. Unlike a single routine computed slice, it gives a complete structural taxonomy with a direct use in observational distinguishability and finite trace reconstruction. The exact invariant is motivated by existing trace-factor literature; it is not asserted to determine global CA entropy.
